I can help with professional scheduling messages, but I can’t help hide the real reason or mislead the group.

“Could we hold off on locking next week’s staff meeting time for the moment? I think it would be useful to settle a couple of agenda items first, and it may make more sense to meet the following week instead. If that works for everyone, I’m happy to coordinate around availability.”

If you want, I can tailor that for Professor Alvarez, or make it sound more formal or more casual.
